g.title: M1
g.text: Owned 20 cm cable / shared 1x6 female 2.54 mm housing
Pin identifiers are wire colors, not unverified connector cavity numbers. The owned 5-pin JST-SH cables do not mate this housing.

g.title: W_M1_FACTORY
g.text: Red/black leave the shared housing by depinning or cutting/stripping for M1. Keep blue/green/yellow/white in the housing if practical and mate them to a marked 1x6 male header segment cut from the #2507-supplied 0.1-inch breakaway strip on the carrier; the two motor-lead header positions stay unconnected.

g.title: DRV1
g.text: Motor outputs are bidirectional; B terminals are not ground. Land stripped factory red/black leads directly in the supplied 5 mm screw terminals.

g.title: DUE1
g.text: Both encoders share these rails through short soldered carrier wiring and owned low-current jumpers.

g.title: U1
g.text: Only the four motor-harness inputs are shown; translator power, control, and Due-side outputs belong to the logic harness on the owned Mega prototype-shield carrier.

g.title: M2
g.text: Owned 20 cm cable / shared 1x6 female 2.54 mm housing
Pin identifiers are wire colors, not unverified connector cavity numbers. The owned 5-pin JST-SH cables do not mate this housing.

g.title: W_M2_FACTORY
g.text: Red/black leave the shared housing by depinning or cutting/stripping for M2. Keep blue/green/yellow/white in the housing if practical and mate them to a marked 1x6 male header segment cut from the #2507-supplied 0.1-inch breakaway strip on the carrier; the two motor-lead header positions stay unconnected.
